title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar says an "IPO is not on the cards right now", and that OpenAI hopes the US government might backstop the financing of data center deals (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)

title: Hassett pivots to possible 'Trump cards' amid credit card interest rate battle with banks
summary: Trump called for banks to cap credit card interest rates at 10%, an idea that has been roundly rejected by industry executives and their lobbyists this week.

title: 'Credit-score company encouraged me to borrow again when I was nearly debt-free'
